Here is a comprehensive overview of the hotel brands most commonly considered by owners and developers in Mexico for **design-forward or distinctive-character lifestyle positioning**:

---

## 🏨 Lifestyle & Design-Forward Hotel Brands in Mexico

### 1. **Grupo Habita** *(Homegrown Mexican Pioneer)*

citations.title: The Magic Formula that Made Grupo Habita a Top Hotelier

content.text: Founded in 2000 by Carlos Couturier along with brothers Jaime, Moisés, and Rafael Micha, Grupo Habita opened its first property—Habita Hotel in Mexico City's Polanco neighborhood—at a time when boutique hospitality was still finding its footing.
The group has since expanded across Mexico, from Puerto Escondido to Oaxaca.

citations.cited_text: The restaurant at Otro Oaxaca seamlessly flows into the shady patio · Grupo Habita’s pioneering spirit first led to the area with the original Hotel E...
citations.title: 2025 Development Update: Mexico | Hospitality Design

content.text: Grupo Habita's pioneering spirit first led to Puerto Escondido with the original Hotel Escondido in 2013, then came the Escondido Oaxaca Hotel in 2019, followed by the 2022 opening of Hotel Terrestre.

Their properties are widely regarded as a benchmark for culturally rooted, design-led hospitality in Mexico.

---

### 2. **Design Hotels™** *(Soft Brand / Curated Collection)*

citations.cited_text: Founded in 2000 by Carlos Couturier along with brothers Jaime, Moises, and Rafael Micha, Grupo Habita opened its first property—Habita Hotel in Mexico...
citations.title: The Magic Formula that Made Grupo Habita a Top Hotelier

content.text: Grupo Habita's properties are part of Design Hotels, a curated collection of independent hotels that prioritize distinctive design and cultural authenticity. The affiliation connects boutique properties with a global network of travelers seeking accommodations that reflect local character rather than standardized brand aesthetics. Design Hotels, now partnered with Marriott Bonvoy, provides marketing reach and booking infrastructure while allowing member hotels to maintain their individual identities and creative direction.

This makes it a popular platform for independent Mexican boutique owners who want global reach without sacrificing their design identity.

---

It is one of the most sought-after lifestyle flags for owners seeking a high-design, culturally resonant identity.

### 6. **SLS Hotels** *(Ennismore)*

content.text: SLS Playa Mujeres made its debut in 2024 as the brand's first all-inclusive offering of the kind. Situated in a private gated waterfront community, the resort, brought to life by Ennismore's in-house design team, balances 498 guestrooms with 18 restaurants and bars.

SLS is known for its bold, pop-art-influenced design language and is increasingly considered by Mexican resort owners looking for a statement lifestyle flag.

---

### 7. **Hyde & The Hoxton** *(Ennismore)*

### 9. **Rosewood Hotels & Resorts** *(Independent Luxury)*

content.text: Rosewood positions itself as "A Sense of Place®" and aims to weave local culture into every aspect of the stay. This brand blends historic renovations with modern comforts, attracting culturally curious, design-savvy travelers.

Rosewood has a strong and growing presence in Mexico, from its iconic Mayakoba property to branded residences in development.

---

### 10. **Autograph Collection** *(Marriott Soft Brand)*
A popular soft-brand platform for independent, design-driven Mexican properties that want to retain their distinctive identity while accessing Marriott Bonvoy's global distribution. Properties like Hacienda Del Mar Los Cabos operate under this flag, which is described by Marriott as a collection of "exactly like nothing else" hotels.

---

### 11. **Auberge Resorts Collection** *(Independent Luxury Lifestyle)*
Auberge has a notable presence in Mexico through properties like Esperanza and Chileno Bay in Los Cabos — both strongly positioned on design character and experiential luxury. It appeals to owners of high-end coastal or resort assets seeking a refined yet intimate lifestyle brand.

---

Its spa programs, architectural purity, and cultural immersion make each stay feel like a wellness retreat.

Amanvari on Baja's East Cape is one of its upcoming Mexico properties.

Dream and Unscripted are increasingly considered by owners in emerging, culturally rich Mexican destinations.
